| description = Triggered by the death of the griffon [[a Soul Carrier]] immediately to your left when facing the front door of the windmill on island 4.  Once he is up he will despawn after 90 minutes on the nose and immediately trigger the Keeper of Souls to spawn.

From Keeper of Souls Page:  Nottap spawns upon the Soul Carrier's death and has a despawn time of exactly 2 hours and 30 minutes. Once Nottap despawns you can kill another Soul Carrier and trigger another Keeper of Souls in 60-100 minutes time.

When pulling mobs back to earlier islands to start Keeper's timer early make sure you have a tracker peep their track list for Nottap. Once Nottap appears on track the despawn/KoS timer will be active and you can begin clearing through Sky as normal.

== Mike Patton==
Nottap Ekim's name reversed is "Mike Patton". It's speculated that this references the lead singer of Faith No More and Mr. Bungle. One of the songs by Mr. Bungle was titled "The Raging Wrath of the Easter Bunny", which may be referenced by [[Sirran the Lunatic]]'s aggro message, "What?! Now you've done it! The bunnies are angry! ANGRY I TELL YOU!".
